_meta.name: Pneumococcal vaccination, ≥65 years, CDC adult coverage
_meta.note: CDC adult-coverage estimate of pneumococcal vaccination among adults aged 65 years or older, assigned to the publisher's survey calendar year. It is kept separate from the historical NHIS HUS Table 069 series; matching age scope alone does not establish instrument continuity.
_meta.breaks: none known; continuity with the historical HUS NHIS series is not assumed.
